root_cause: The new owner portal counted verified executive outcomes but did not expose source-pinned realized EUR and recovered hours from the canonical Brain verified-value projection. A naive UI could double-count reused evidence or treat approval, forecast or expected economics as realized business value.
prevention_rule: Derive displayed realized value only from the tenant-bound verifiedValues server projection that already requires execution, independent verification, realized flag and evidence IDs. Enforce client tenant exact match; de-duplicate unique id and reused proof per unit; keep EUR/time separated, reject unsupported units, omit unsupported date-window claims and fail closed on missing projection.
